problem.title: Product of Array Except Self
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; Chinese explanation independently paraphrased
facts: Return answer[i] as the product of every nums[j] where j != i.
The algorithm must run in O(n) time and must not use division.
The follow-up asks for O(1) extra space excluding the output array.
2 <= nums.length <= 10^5; each nums[i] is between -30 and 30; each prefix/suffix product fits in 32-bit integer.

claims.claim: answer[i] equals product(nums[0:i]) multiplied by product(nums[i+1:n]).
claims.validation: Prefix and suffix definitions in article.

claims.claim: A left-to-right pass writes each strict prefix product into the output array; a right-to-left pass multiplies the strict suffix product into it.
claims.validation: Loop invariant for both passes and solution.py.

claims.claim: Time O(n); O(1) auxiliary variables beyond the output array; zeros work without special cases.
claims.validation: Two linear passes and exhaustive tests including zero-heavy inputs.
